title: Draft color selection is non-deterministic (missing HashMap tie-break)

scenario.harness: harness/src/main.rs (issue6337 v0.103.0): find_best_colors, dominant_colors, and find_best_colors_fixed copied VERBATIM from v0.103.0 sources; DraftCardInstance/CardDatabase replaced by local stubs; score_card stub returns constant 1.0 (the issue's tie repro pool: one card of each of W/U/B/R/G)

scope: draft-wasm/phase-ai color-selection helpers on v0.103.0 sources; 30 separate OS processes over the issue's tied repro pool; no game states exist for a deckbuilder report
result: Re-validated on v0.103.0 sources: find_best_colors top-2 varied across runs (15 distinct orderings in 30 processes). suggest.rs, bot_ai.rs, draft_eval.rs all byte-identical to v0.102.0; the score-only sort at suggest.rs:376 still has no tie-break. color_preference still delegates to deterministic dominant_colors (B,G in all 30 runs), as does the house-style control.
limitations: Browser/UI "Suggest deck" click path not exercised; the helper function it calls is exercised verbatim from the release sources.
Real score_card gives per-card quality scores; constant score reproduces the reported tie condition only.
No engine game states apply to this subsystem (per playbook deckbuilder rule).
driver_notes: Re-validation only: no engine server interaction needed; sources verified via minisign before use.
